name: wexel
description: WebAssembly execution runtime and JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for controlled embedded runtimes.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wexel/core build && node scripts/build-core.mjs && pnpm --filter wexel build && mkdir -p packages/wexel/assets && cp packages/wexel-core/dist/core.wasm packages/wexel/assets/core.wasm && node scripts/check-browser-budget.mjs
